d:
Lyricist and poet Manoj Muntashir is in Newsroom Baithki. He speaks openly on the allegations of being anti-Muslim and trolling on Adipurush. Manoj Muntashir also clarified on his statement on Rahul Gandhi having a foreign mother. Along with this, he also talks about Kumar Vishwas and his dispute with Kumar. Manoj Muntashir had an arguments in the newsroom regarding Brahminism and secularism, watch his full interview with Saurabh Dwivedi.

Edited By: Shakir khan
